title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.01595v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $\tau_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. translated_title: 在其消逝之前：在VideoLLMs中于推理阶段强化时间表征
translated_abstract: 视频大语言模型按顺序接收帧，并解释视觉内容如何沿时间轴演变，然而时间推理仍然是各种架构中普遍存在的弱点。反转视频的帧顺序——这一变换本应使时间性答案随之反转——却常常使最终预测保持不变。我们通过定义时间散度向量 τ_l（即由反转时间顺序所引起的逐层表征差异）来探究这一失败的根源。追踪其幅值在各层中的变化揭示出一个一致的时间散度剖面：散度在中间层达到峰值，并朝输出方向逐渐减弱。我们确认该峰值是时间推理所特有的，并且对预测具有功能性关键作用，从而确立了VideoLLMs在中间层获取时间信息，但未能将其维持到输出层。这种渐进式的……
tldr: VideoLLMs在中间层获取时间信息但无法保持到输出层，本文通过定义时间散度向量揭示时间表征逐层衰减的现象，并提出在推理时强化时间表征以提升时间推理能力。
en_tdlr: VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output; by defining temporal divergence vectors to reveal this layer-wise fading of temporal signals, the paper reinforces temporal representations at inference time to improve temporal reasoning.
